existing caplog containment guard _rebar_log_propagation_guard covers only the rebar root logger and misses the sibling rebar_reconciler root
generalizing the guard to cover both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots via SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES tuple eliminates the order dependency by restoring logger levels in test setup/teardown
